LanguageData.SocSetts.Addons.title: Addons
LanguageData.SocSetts.AcceleratingParticles.label: Accelerating Particles
LanguageData.SocSetts.AcceleratingParticles.desc:
Adds new content including ion thrusters, anti‑thrusters, and antiproton capsules.

In the future, new elements will be added, such as the anti‑reactor, photon turret, and dual ion thruster.

This checkbox removes things from the construction menu and crafting menu, if unchecked.
LanguageData.SocSetts.SmallNuclearEngine.label: Small Nuclear Engine
LanguageData.SocSetts.SmallNuclearEngine.desc: A small nuclear-powered engine capable of launching a ship into orbit. Not suitable for interplanetary travel.\n\nThis checkbox removes things from the construction menu and crafting menu, if unchecked.
LanguageData.SocSetts.ShipCargoTerminal.label: Ship Cargo Terminal
LanguageData.SocSetts.ShipCargoTerminal.desc: Adds a specialized cargo terminal for ships with increased storage capacity.\n\nThis checkbox removes the building from the construction menu, if unchecked.
LanguageData.SocSetts.Ships.title: Ships
LanguageData.SocSetts.StarSectorShips.label: StarSector
LanguageData.SocSetts.StarSectorShips.desc: A collection of ships in the style of the StarSector game. Includes several destroyers and frigates with a combat rating of 1000, and other types of ships - fighters, bombers, cargo ships, shuttles.\n\n- Ships have been reworked, the original version was created by Antisodium.
LanguageData.SocSetts.X4FoundationsShips.label: X4 Foundations
LanguageData.SocSetts.X4FoundationsShips.desc: A collection of ships in the style of the X4 Foundations game. Includes several large ships with a combat rating of 2000, like the Asgard cruiser, and other ship classes - fighters, frigates, cargo ships, destroyers.
LanguageData.SocSetts.DifferentShips.label: Various Ships
LanguageData.SocSetts.DifferentShips.desc: A collection of various ships and structures that do not fall into other categories. May contain stations, mini-ships, fighters, cargo ships, frigates, destroyers, and cruisers.
LanguageData.SocSetts.Patches.Title: Patches
LanguageData.SocSetts.LifeSupportEnergy.label: Energy Patch
LanguageData.SocSetts.LifeSupportEnergy.desc: Reduces the energy consumption of the life support system by 2x, and the small life support system by 3x.
LanguageData.SocSetts.RussianTranslation.label: Translation Patch
LanguageData.SocSetts.RussianTranslation.desc: Replaces the text "Hover Mode" with "Режим парения" in the shuttle interface. Apply if want to learn some Russian words.
LanguageData.SocSetts.Graphics.title: Graphics
LanguageData.SocSetts.OdysseyHullGraphics.label: Odyssey Hull Graphics
LanguageData.SocSetts.OdysseyHullGraphics.desc: Ship hull graphics from the Odyssey. Replaces hull, vents and solar panels. Does not replace mech and archo hulls.
LanguageData.SocSetts.OdysseyThrustersGraphics.label: Odyssey Thrusters Graphics
LanguageData.SocSetts.OdysseyThrustersGraphics.desc: Ship thruster graphics from the Odyssey. Replaces chemical engines graphics.
LanguageData.SocSetts.RCSLayerFix.label: RCS Engine Layer Fix
LanguageData.SocSetts.RCSLayerFix.desc: Sets the RCS thruster render layer to FloorEmplacement so it displays more correctly.
LanguageData.SocSetts.SOSNuclearThrusterGraphics.desc: Replaces the graphics of nuclear thrusters, adjusting the isometric nozzle perspective to a more accurate level.
LanguageData.SocSetts.SOSSalvageBayGraphics.label: SOS Salvage Bay Graphics
LanguageData.SocSetts.SOSSalvageBayGraphics.desc: Replaces the graphics of salvage bays, removing the mechanical claw. This ensures that items placed on this structure appear correctly.
LanguageData.SocSetts.SOSChemEnginesGraphics.label: SOS Chemical Engines Graphics
LanguageData.SocSetts.SOSChemEnginesGraphics.desc: Replaces the graphics of chemical engines, adjusting the isometric nozzle perspective to a more accurate level.
LanguageData.SocSetts.SOSShuttleBayGraphics.label: SOS Shuttle Bay Graphics
LanguageData.SocSetts.SOSShuttleBayGraphics.desc: Replaces the graphics of shuttle bays, removing the rings on the platform that were designed for older shuttle models in the RimWorld 1.2 mod version.
LanguageData.SocSetts.SOSRCSEnginesGraphics.label: SOS RCS Engines Graphics
LanguageData.SocSetts.SOSRCSEnginesGraphics.desc: Replaces the graphics of RCS thrusters, adjusting the isometric perspective.
